name: mc_blueprint
title: Blueprints
description:
Stores reusable blueprints and generates bounded roofs, arches, towers and stairs as ordinary components. All actions operate on persistent documents, not world blocks.

WHEN TO USE: reusable windows, columns, towers or rooms; preserving an overall design across calls or agent sessions. Optionally generate a named architectural part, or save your own design, then build with mc_build({blueprint:{id:...},transform:{origin:[x,y,z],...}}). Components use the same fills/blocks/text entries and block orientation rules as mc_build.
WHEN NOT TO USE: terrain inspection, block placement or previews. Use mc_build to place a saved blueprint.

PARAMETERS: action save/get/list/delete/generate; generate requires id and generator:{kind,...}. Roof styles gable/hip/shed, arch round/pointed, tower circular, stairs straight/switchback. Optional materials:{full,stairs,slab}; see kind schemas for defaults/dimensions. Generation is additive, never clears openings/interiors. Local axes and assumptions returned; apply existing build transforms/palette overrides. Use connect:false for explicit roof corners. Overwrite is opt-in. Generation caps 200,000 requested cells/10,000 operations and validates native states before saving; build still honors current world/read/write limits.  id is 1-64 lowercase characters (letter first, then letters/digits/_/-). save requires a version-1 document and explicit overwrite:true to replace an existing ID. A document contains named flat components and ordered instances with local pos, optional rotation/mirror and repeat:{count,step}. Repetition step is in the project frame. Components can use $role or $role[property=value] for materials; inline properties override palette properties. Precedence: component defaults < document palette < mc_build blueprint.palette < instance palette. Sign strings and lettering content are not substituted. dimensions and constraints are advisory metadata, not enforced design rules. Nested components are not supported in version 1.

SIDE EFFECTS: save/generate/delete modify persistent blueprint files only; no world changes. get/list are read-only. Maximum 256 documents, 2 MiB per document, 128 components, 10,000 raw operations and 4,096 expanded instances. Saving validates structure, not native block states or all role bindings; mc_build validates compiled states before any writes and applies server build limits. Deleting a blueprint never removes already-built structures.

overwrite.description: save/generate only. Default false; explicit true permits replacement.

generator.description: generate only. Canonical local axes: gable ridge Z, shed uphill east, arches XY/depth Z, stairs uphill south then north for switchback. Footprints include intended eaves; no terrain adaptation/implicit clearing. Optional materials full (solid block), stairs (stair state), slab (slab state). Defaults: stone bricks for arches/towers, oak stairs/planks for stairs, dark oak roof materials. Output is a saved ordinary version-1 blueprint plus bounded geometry summary, not world placement.

gableInfill.description: Gable only; fills end triangles below the roof. Slope 1:1.

height.description: Pier/spring-line height, not total crown height.

rise.description: Pointed only; <= (width+1)/2, defaults to that maximum.

merlons.description: Requires battlements; alternating angular sectors, voxel approximations.

gap.description: Switchback only, empty well between flights.

supports.description: Solid plinths under flights/landings; not terrain-aware foundations.

document.description: save only. Flat components, with local coordinates. Dimensions and constraints are retained as metadata.

constraints.description: Optional advisory project requirements. Preserved verbatim; not enforced yet.

palette.description: Role name -> literal block state. No recursive $role bindings.

components.description: Names follow the same format as id. Each component has raw mc_build operations and optional material defaults. No nested instances.

block.description: Literal block state or $role, optionally with [properties] to override palette properties.

filter.description: Partial block-state filter, including optional $role. Omitted properties remain wildcards.

block.description: Literal block state or $role[property=value]. Orientation rules are the same as mc_build; supply both door/bed halves.

component.description: Name of a component in this document.
